subtitulo: Ya había salido: already, before something else happened.
regla: Ya (already) goes before haber or after the participle, never between them: ya había comido / había comido ya.

bloques.texto: **Ya** means _already_. With the pluperfect it says something was done before another past moment: **ya había comido cuando llegaste**.
Where does **ya** go? At the start of the verb group, **before haber**, or at the end of it, **after the participle**. It can also come later, after other parts of the sentence.

filas.t: Beto ya había comprado una tabla nueva.
Beto había comprado ya una tabla nueva.

bloques.texto: What it can't do is sit between **haber** and the participle, the way _already_ does in English (_had already bought_).
Tip: **había** + participle is one block, like a tabla with its leash. **Ya** waits at either end.

lista.es: ==Ya había abierto== el carro cuando llegó el cliente.
lista.en: I had already opened the car when the customer arrived.

lista.es: ==Ya habías entendido== la técnica cuando el profe la explicó.
lista.en: You had already understood the technique when the coach explained it.

lista.es: Amos ==había salido ya== cuando se acordó de las herramientas.
lista.en: Amos had already left when he remembered the tools.

lista.es: ==Ya nos habíamos dormido== cuando llegó el paquete.
lista.en: We had already fallen asleep when the package arrived.

lista.es: Antes del partido, ==ya habíamos pedido== los tacos.
lista.en: Before the game, we had already ordered the tacos.

lista.es: Para las ocho y media, ==ya habías terminado== el pastel.
lista.en: By eight thirty, you had already finished the cake.

bloques.texto: English puts _already_ in the middle. Spanish doesn't.

lista.nota: The pronoun goes before **haber**, and **ya** before the pronoun.

lista.texto: How the tense is built: [[5843|regular]] and [[5049|irregular]] pluperfect.
The opposite, _not yet_: [[6007|aún no / todavía no with the pluperfect]].
**Ya** with the preterite: [[9263|ya with the preterite]].
_Not anymore_ and other meanings: [[7263|ya / ya no]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _The waves had already gone down when we arrived._
lista.r: Las olas ya habían bajado cuando llegamos.
Ya habíamos cenado. / Habíamos cenado ya.
lista.nota: Never between haber and the participle.
